name: Crushing Wave Initiate
tactics: Initiates close to melee swiftly, marking enemies and then using stroke of lightning whenever possible.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

items.name: Chainmail
items.description:
Metal rings woven together into a shirt, leggings, and a hood make up a suit of chainmail. Chainmail grants good protection, but it’s cumbersome, so it reduces your mobility and agility.
	Magic appears at higher item levels, and grants higher armor bonuses than its mundane counterparts. Chainmail grants +8 AC at levels 11-15, +9 AC at levels 16-20, +10 AC at levels 21-25, and +12 AC at levels 26-30.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

hit.description: lightning damage, and the target is marked until the end of the encounter, until the initiate is knocked unconscious, or until another mark supersedes this one

lightning damage, and the initiate teleports the target to a space of the initiate’s choosing within 8 squares of the initiate that does not include hindering terrain. The initiate then makes a secondary attack, which is a close burst 1 centered on the target

powers.name: Elemental Assault
powers.trigger: when an enemy marked by the initiate and within 10 squares of it hits with an attack that does not include the initiate

effect.description: The initiate teleports to a square adjacent to the triggering enemy and makes a longsword attack as a free action.

The Crushing Wave initiate shifts 6 squares. During this movement, the initiate can move across liquid and through enemies’ spaces, ignoring difficult terrain and hazardous terrain effects. It takes no penalties for squeezing during this movement.
